simple.summary: שַׂרְסְכִים (Sarçᵉkîym) means Sarsekim , a Babylonian general First listed occurrence: Jer 39 3.

definitions.full: H8310. Sarsekim שַׂרְסְכִים proper name, masculine a prince of Nebuchadnezzar Jer 39:3 , but read probably שַׁזְבָּן (נְבוֺ) , see Gie Du, compare p. 613:a above; ᵐ5 Ναβουσαχαρ , etc.
